name: Fix log help
description: Help mode entries of the Fix log plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Fix log
entries.text: What Claude sessions found that needs fixing, what they tried, what failed and what fixed it. Each line also reached your phone as an FYI; nothing here needs an answer.

entries.title: Fix log settings
entries.text: Choose which outcomes ring the bell and your phone, the flood limit per session, and how many lines are kept. Every line is always logged.

entries.title: Outcome
entries.text: Shows only lines with this outcome: needs fixing, trying, failed or fixed. Not fixed yet shows the first three.

entries.title: Flood limit
entries.text: How many notifications one session may send in 10 minutes. Past it, lines are still logged but stop ringing your phone until the 10 minutes pass.

entries.title: Lines kept
entries.text: How many Fix log lines are kept. The oldest are dropped past this number.

entries.title: Clear
entries.text: Clears every filter and shows all lines again.

entries.title: Refresh
entries.text: Loads the newest lines now. The page also refreshes by itself every 15 seconds.

entries.title: Whole fix
entries.text: Shows only the lines of this one fix, from what needed fixing to fixed.

entries.title: Show all
entries.text: Leaves the one-fix view and shows every line again.

entries.title: Needs fixing
entries.text: A session found something broken and is about to fix it.

entries.title: Trying
entries.text: What the session is trying now.

entries.title: Failed
entries.text: That try did not work. The next line says what it tries next.

entries.title: Fixed
entries.text: The fix worked. The fix is closed.

steps.say: Every line here is a step a Claude session took to fix something, and it was sent to your phone as an FYI.
Filter by outcome, session or build, or tap Whole fix to see one fix from start to end.
